## Recovered observations

25 points (from FA-4) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Single curve with no markers; about 40 deg at Dr 0 to 48.5 at Dr 1.0 with a bend near Dr 0.5. Differs by about 1 deg from the FC-16 average (about 39.8 to 49) and F2-23 RS so it is a separate drawing. Text phi: soil 1 about 41 (curve 40 at Dr 0; Table 2-3 40); soil 3 about 43.9 (Table 2-3 44.5); soil 4 about 47.9 (Table 2-3 47.3). Reprinted under soils 3 and 4.
- Codex: Author curve; points and bounds omitted. Also specifications 3 and 4. Geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-4, printed A-8, PDF 9
